notes:
v4.6.31 — Paper/Live independence + IBKR bot management & live data

🔀 PAPER vs LIVE ARE NOW FULLY INDEPENDENT
• Each trading mode (Paper / Live) has its own bot list, cash allocations, and auto-start-at-open settings. Unsilencing or configuring a bot in Paper no longer touches Live (and vice-versa). Switching the header toggle swaps the whole working set.
• Bot registry, IBKR config, and auto-schedule are keyed per mode; existing setups migrate automatically into Paper on first launch.

🏦 IBKR TOOLS — ADD / REPLACE BOTS + % ALLOCATION
• LONG / SHORT / DAY are now IBKR-compatible and appear in the library + Client-ID table (previously you were stuck with them invisible).
• Add ANY bot — built-ins or your custom bots from any broker — to the IBKR Client-ID & allocation table.
• Allocate a PERCENTAGE of account cash per bot (was fixed dollars), with a live 'Allocated X% · Remaining Y%' indicator.
• Each bot row has a ↔ Replace button: pick a replacement bot; the new bot inherits the slot's Client ID + allocation and (on first run) auto-liquidates positions outside its asset class.
• IBKR settings are saved separately for Paper and Live.

📊 OVERVIEW SHOWS IBKR DATA IN IBKR MODE
• New ib_async data adapter reads your real IBKR account (equity / cash / positions) instead of falling back to the Alpaca account. Per-bot numbers are scoped by Client ID + allocation %. Requires a reachable IB Gateway/TWS.
• Fixed: Alpaca data layer no longer hardcoded paper — Live mode now reads the live account.

☁ CLOUD BOTS KEEP TRADING WHEN YOU SWITCH BROKERS
• Switching broker or Paper/Live no longer stops cloud (run-on-Oracle) bots — they keep trading 24/7 and their tabs reconnect to the running server bot. Only local subprocess bots stop on a view switch.
